name: craftsman
description: A HUMAN <-> AI loop for coding, requirements analysis and domain design, driven by directives and protocols the developer authored, not by a hardcoded process.

plugins.name: craftsman
plugins.description: Orchestrates directives (what must be true) and protocols (what order to work in) through a checkpoint-gated HUMAN <-> AI loop. Ships with /craftsman:analyse, /craftsman:domain-design, /craftsman:implement, /craftsman:search and management commands.
